payload.content:
For admission to a UAEU masters program taught predominantly in English, applicants must have a related accredited bachelor degree with a minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale or equivalent, and an IELTS Academic score of at least 6.0 or equivalent, with the language test taken within two years of application.

Applicants with a bachelor GPA between 2.5 and below 3.0 may be conditionally admitted, requiring them to take at most 9 credit hours in the first semester and achieve a GPA of 3.0 in those hours to continue; otherwise, they face dismissal.

Applicants with an IELTS Academic score of 5.5 may be conditionally admitted, needing to achieve 6.0 by the end of the first semester, initially take no more than 6 credit hours excluding intensive English, and obtain a GPA of 3.0 in the first 9 credit-bearing hours.
